findings.description: Only return draft messages matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box. For example, `"from:someuser@example.com rfc822msgid: is:unread"`.
findings.endpoint_description: Lists the drafts in the user's mailbox.
findings.source_evidence: Official Gmail API docs, every SDK (googleapis, simplegmail, ezgmail), gws CLI, and both major MCP servers expose this parameter as 'q' — it is the ecosystem-standard name for the Gmail search query.
findings.skip_reason: q is the universally recognized Gmail search-query parameter name; renaming on generated endpoint commands would break parity with all Gmail documentation. The hand-built 'find' command provides the friendly positional-query UX.
